summary: Iteration 6 — ANCR-integration-ready notifications verified end-to-end. Added /app/backend/tests/test_ancr_envelope.py (28 tests, 28 pass). Backend coverage: (a) GET /api/notifications/link-registry public+no-auth returns ancr_notifications_enabled=false, 5 links with ids {reviews.event, reviews.project, faculty.project, faculty.dashboard, project.command_center} and 5 event_types {review.written, review.time_coded, review.coverage_response, review.rubric, review.status}; (b) POST /api/notifications/resolve-link resolves each of the 5 link classes and returns 404 for '/random/nowhere', '/reviews' (missing project), '/reviews?review=abc' (missing project), 'not-a-path', and '' — enforces auth (401 without token); (c) POST /faculty/projects/proj-mv-neon-heart/reviews for each kind (written, time_coded, coverage_response, rubric, status) produces exactly one notification each with ancr_ready=true and event_type mapped per REVIEW_KIND_TO_EVENT; (d) GET /api/notifications/{id}/envelope returns actor={user_id:'demo-faculty-001',name:'Prof. Idris Bello',ancrid:null}, recipient={user_id:'demo-student-001',ancrid:null}, subject={kind:'project',id:'proj-mv-neon-heart',title:'Neon Heart'}, payload.review_id matches, ancr_ready=true, ancr_emitted_at=null, channels[in_app]='delivered' with delivered_at set + channels[ancr_bus]='not_configured' (correct because ANCR_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=false), link_registry_match.id='reviews.event'; (e) envelope owner-guard: cross-owner attacker → 404, invalid note_id → 404, no auth → 401/403; (f) EVERY deep_link on EVERY notification in the student inbox resolves via /resolve-link (5 review notifications, all pass; a legacy seeded 'n-1' feedback notification without deep_link is skipped because it predates the registry and is not type='review'); (g) live route sanity: /api/projects/{pid}/reviews returns 200 for owner and assigned faculty, and 403/404 for an unassigned attacker; (h) regression: seeded rev-nh-1..5 preserved after new inserts. Full regression: 40/40 test_security_authz.py + 22/22 test_review_notifications.py still pass. Frontend E2E via Playwright: TopBar bell shows ANCR-ready gold badges (46 visible in test env because prior iterations accumulated review notifications); clicking a review item marked it read, navigated to /reviews?project=proj-mv-neon-heart&review=<rid>, and the student-review-<rid> row rendered with cyan ring highlight; /projects/proj-mv-neon-heart (command center) renders Neon Heart title; /reviews?project=proj-mv-neon-heart renders Reviews page; faculty login → /faculty renders dashboard content and /faculty/projects/proj-mv-neon-heart renders the Neon Heart review workspace (feedback + rubric + status controls) without console errors.
action_items: OPTIONAL data-quality follow-up: the seeded notification id 'n-1' in /app/backend/seed_data.py (type='feedback') carries no deep_link. It does not violate the ANCR contract (defense refuses to emit unregistered links; this row was inserted directly by seed, not the pipeline), but if you want the invariant 'every notification carries an ANCR-shaped envelope' to hold universally, either delete that seed row or upgrade it to type='review' with deep_link '/reviews?project=proj-mv-neon-heart&review=rev-nh-1' plus the envelope fields. The test file skips the check for non-'review' rows so this is not a blocker.
critical_code_review_comments: ancr_notifications.py is clean and well-scoped (~207 lines): sinks are pluggable, Dispatcher.dispatch never raises (per-sink try/except), AncrBusSink returns 'not_configured' when the flag is off — matches spec exactly.

resolve_deep_link correctly handles missing/None/malformed input, path regex is anchored, and required_query is validated against parsed query — no false positives observed across the parametrized negative cases.

_spawn_review_notification calls resolve_deep_link before emit and short-circuits with logger.error if unregistered — good defensive posture. Because the emit link is fixed as '/reviews?project=<pid>&review=<rid>' this is unreachable today, but the guard is correct.
GET /api/notifications/link-registry is intentionally public (no auth) — reasonable for an outbound contract manifest. If the ANCR spec later restricts this to registered bus consumers, gate it then.
server.py is now ~1736 lines — restating iteration-5's suggestion to split into routers (auth, projects, notifications, faculty, ai, sync_studio). Not blocking.
Notification model correctly stores envelope fields inline and channels as a list — makes GET /api/notifications a single-round-trip render for the bell popover.
MongoDB _id is excluded via projection everywhere the notification is read (line 581 uses {_id:0}). Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows (ANCR badge, deep-link nav, highlight, faculty routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: ANCR notifications MVP validated — envelope canon, link registry, sink dispatch, and deep_link enforcement all pass. AncrBusSink is intentionally 'not_configured' (do NOT flip ANCR_NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED in future iterations until the real bus is wired). When ANCR ships, expect the ancr_bus channel to move from 'not_configured' -> 'pending' -> 'delivered', and ancr_emitted_at will become non-null; the envelope shape itself must NOT change. Legacy seed row 'n-1' has no deep_link — flagged as optional follow-up. Next testing agent: reuse /app/backend/tests/test_ancr_envelope.py as regression.
